query:
SELECT g.owner_id,
                   g.permissions,
                   (SELECT r.name FROM user_roles ur
                    JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id
                    WHERE ur.user_id = $1 AND ur.tenant_id = g.id) AS "tenant_role?",
                   EXISTS (
                       SELECT 1 FROM user_roles
                       WHERE user_id = $1 AND tenant_id IS NULL AND role_id = $3
                   ) AS "is_superadmin!"
            FROM groups g
            WHERE g.id = $2
